newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Alpha Healthcare says to complete deal.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Healthcare says to complete deal.

text.p: Private hospital operator Alpha Healthcare Ltd said it should complete the A$37.7 million purchase of Health Care Corp Pty Ltd in mid-July following shareholder approval for the deal on Monday.
Alpha said the acquisition, from James Hardie Industries and Leighton Holdings, would make it New South Wales' second largest private hospital operator, with over 800 beds under its control.

Managing director Paul Hopper said the company would now finalise funding for the proposed Westmead private hospital, a tertiary care 140-bed hospital to be built near the Westmead public hospital in Sydney's western suburbs.
The Westmead private hospital was expected to cost about A$44 million and be operational by the end of the 1999 financial year.
The Health Care Corp purchase was part funded by an investment of A$15 million in Alpha by Sun Healthcare Group Inc, which will hold 38.2 percent of Alpha.
